summary: A mixed day with one significant legal judgment, retail expansion moves by major players, and policy/business developments. Focus areas: court rulings affecting legal strategy, e-commerce/quick commerce scaling, and sector-wide investment signals.

bullets.text: Bengaluru court pardons Pradosh Rao in Renukaswamy murder case, converting him to approver in key criminal proceeding.
Amazon expands quick-commerce fashion play via Amazon Now to 300 cities, escalating retail competition.
Nestle CEO signals major India market investment roadmap, positioning country as key growth driver.
Reliance launches Jio CallAgent AI service integrated into network infrastructure for enterprise applications.
Google settles UK app developer lawsuit for $353M, signaling compliance shift on Play Store practices.
